choices.reason: Neither candidate is explicitly designated primary, but the abstract reports the group difference in growth trajectories, corresponding to the latent creativity slope. The adjusted comparison is introduced as a subsequent check of whether the advantage remains after covariate adjustment, so the growth specification reported in the abstract takes priority under rule 2.

choices.quote: Results indicated that the experimental group began with higher initial levels and demonstrated steeper growth trajectories, reflecting a Matthew effect, while the control group displayed compensatory tendencies.
